sentences.text:
This Criminal Petition Is Filed By The vs Unknown on 13 July,
2020
 The Honourable Smt Justice Lalitha Kanneganti
 Criminal Petition No.2517 of 2020
O R D E R:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners/A-6 and 14 to 16 under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking to quash all further proceedings in Crime No.190 of 2020 on the file of I Town Police Station, Kavali, Nellore District.

entities.text: I Town Police Station, Kavali, Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The offences alleged are under Sections 272 and 273 I.P.C. and Section 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard the counsel for the petitioners/A-6 and A-14 to A-16 and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners so also the learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the issue involved in the present case is squarely covered by the common order, dated 27.08.2018, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch wherein Criminal Petition No.6754 of 2018 was allowed.
He placed on record copy of the said order.

4. Since the issue involved in the present case is identical to the order passed in Criminal Petition No.6754 of 2018 vide common order, dated 27.08.2018, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch, following the said order and in terms thereof, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners/A-6 and A-14 to A-16 in Crime No.190 of 2020 on the file of I Town Police Station, Kavali, Nellore District are hereby quashed.
5. Registry shall enclose a copy of the common order, dated 27.08.2018, of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch to this order.
Miscellaneous Petitions pending, if any, in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
_________________________________ JUSTICE LALITHA KANNEGANTI Date:
